name: com.ainimator.controller
description: Real-time runtime for the AI-nimator deterministic autoregressive controller, powered by Unity Sentis. Loads a frozen controller bundle (controller.onnx + norm_stats.json + manifest.json + presets) exported by the ainimator Python pipeline and drives it one forward-pass per frame. Defines no model: it consumes the bundle as-is (see apps/spec/inference_contract.md, the single source of truth for the I/O contract). Includes button->preset authoring (B3), foot-lock IK + idle/move blending post-processing (B4), and rig binding + prompt-at-runtime (B3-bis, apps/spec/rig_binding.md).

samples.description: A capsule driven by WASD -> ControlPreset bindings (forward/backward/strafe/idle), no IK. Drop CapsuleDemoBootstrap into an empty scene and press Play; it self-configures a capsule + ground + camera and loads the bundle from StreamingAssets/AInimatorBundle.

Drag-and-drop RigDemo.prefab into an empty scene and press Play: a procedural SMPL-22 stick-figure mannequin driven through RigBinder/RigMap (B3-bis), WASD/ZQSD movement presets, 1..9 hot prompt swap (embedding cross-fade), free-text prompt (B7) and text commands (B6). See the sample README for bundle setup.
